why: Codex's stream carries no init event listing its MCP servers, so availability is not readable per run. Without this probe a Codex tool-selection rate of zero has two explanations — the agent declined the tool, or the tool was never there — and the bench cannot say which.
how: codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check with the same -c mcp_servers.cognium config the trial's MCP arms use, and a prompt that instructs the tool be called outright.
conclusion: The server attaches to Codex and find_callers completes. The trial's Codex selection rate of 0/6 on both MCP variants is therefore a choice not to call an available tool, not an absent tool.
